facts: Figure 1 compares measured response at 10 K and 20 K.
Peak positions are 2.00 GHz and 2.06 GHz, respectively.
Bars show supplied calibration uncertainty of 0.01 GHz; coverage and covariance are unspecified.
No mechanism discrimination was performed.

en.caption: FIG. 1. Response peaks at 10 and 20 K. Bars indicate the supplied calibration uncertainty of 0.01 GHz; no confidence level is assigned.
en.results: The peak moves from 2.00 to 2.06 GHz as the temperature increases from 10 to 20 K (Fig. 1), a displacement of 0.06 GHz. Each peak has a stated calibration uncertainty of 0.01 GHz.

zh.caption: 图1. 10 K和20 K时的响应峰位。误差棒表示给定的0.01 GHz校准不确定度，未指定置信水平。
zh.results: 温度从10 K升至20 K时，峰位由2.00 GHz移至2.06 GHz（图1），位移为0.06 GHz。各峰位给定的校准不确定度为0.01 GHz。

facts: Figure 2(a) contains 36 paired observations and a line fitted to those same observations.
Figure 2(b) contains observed minus fitted response for each pair.
No independent validation set or specified residual distribution is supplied.
The intended residual panel includes a horizontal zero-reference line; residual magnitudes or final-size visibility are not specified.

en.caption: FIG. 2. (a) The 36 paired observations and the line fitted to them. (b) Residuals, defined as observed minus fitted response; the horizontal line marks zero.
en.results: Figure 2 pairs the full observation–fit comparison with observed-minus-fitted residuals. Both panels assess the fitted description on the same 36 input observations.

zh.caption: 图2. (a) 36对观测值及用这些观测值拟合的直线。(b) 残差，定义为观测响应减去拟合响应；水平线标出零值。
zh.results: 图2将完整的观测与拟合比较和观测响应减去拟合响应的残差并列呈现，两幅图共同检验拟合对同一组36对输入观测的描述情况。

facts: Figure 3(a) contains raw curves for sizes 16, 32 and 64.
Figure 3(b) divides the horizontal coordinate by square root of size and the response by the fourth root of size.
The author-specified exponents 0.5 and 0.25 were fixed before this display.
The transformed curves overlap over the displayed interval; no exponent fit or larger-size extrapolation is supplied.

en.caption: FIG. 3. (a) Raw curves for sizes 16, 32 and 64. (b) The same curves after dividing the horizontal coordinate by the square root of size and the response by the fourth root of size. The exponents 0.5 and 0.25 are prescribed, not fitted here.
en.results: With the prescribed rescaling, the three curves overlap over the displayed interval [Fig. 3(b)], supporting the proposed scaling description for the sampled sizes.

zh.caption: 图3. (a) 尺寸为16、32和64时的原始曲线。(b) 将横坐标除以尺寸的平方根、响应除以尺寸的四次方根后得到的同一组曲线。指数0.5和0.25为预先给定值，本图未拟合指数。
zh.results: 采用给定的重标度后，三条曲线在图示区间内重合［图3(b)］，支持这一标度描述在所考察尺寸下的适用性。

facts: Figure 4 shows empirical cumulative distributions for groups A and B with 80 uncensored observations each.
At threshold 1.0 s, A contains 60 values at or below the threshold and B contains 44.
No hypothesis test or distribution fit was performed.

en.caption: FIG. 4. Empirical cumulative distributions for groups A and B, each containing 80 uncensored observations. Each step gives the fraction at or below the stated duration; no distribution is fitted.
en.results: At 1.0 s, the sample cumulative fractions are 75% for A and 55% for B (Fig. 4), a difference of 20 percentage points at this threshold.

zh.caption: 图4. A、B两组的经验累积分布，每组包含80个无删失观测。阶梯函数表示时长不超过横坐标值的样本比例，未拟合分布模型。
zh.results: 在1.0 s这一阈值处，A、B两组的样本累积比例分别为75%和55%（图4），相差20个百分点。

facts: Figure 6(a) shows one time-ordered particle trajectory over 5 s.
Figure 6(b) shows streamlines of the velocity field at the initial instant.
The field can vary with time; no equality of pathlines and streamlines is established.
No ensemble statistics are supplied.
The intended trajectory panel marks its start and end points.

en.caption: FIG. 6. (a) One particle trajectory over 5 s, with the start and end marked. (b) Streamlines of the velocity field at the initial instant. The two panels represent a time history and an instantaneous field, respectively.
en.results: Figure 6 separates the particle's time history from the geometry of the initial velocity field. In a time-dependent field, the initial streamline need not coincide with the subsequent trajectory.

zh.caption: 图6. (a) 单个粒子在5 s内的轨迹，标出起点与终点。(b) 初始时刻速度场的流线。两幅图分别描述一段时间历程和一个瞬时场。
zh.results: 图6将粒子的运动历程与初始速度场的几何形态分开呈现。速度场随时间变化时，初始流线不必与后续轨迹重合。

facts: Figure 8 gives the estimated difference A minus B as 1.2 ms.
Its supplied two-sided 95% confidence interval is from -0.8 to 3.2 ms.
No equivalence margin or equivalence test is supplied.
The intended display uses an error bar for the supplied confidence interval and a reference line at zero difference.

en.caption: FIG. 8. Estimated difference A minus B, 1.2 ms. The error bar shows the supplied two-sided 95% confidence interval from −0.8 to 3.2 ms. The reference line marks zero difference.
en.results: The 95% confidence interval spans zero (Fig. 8), leaving the sign of the difference unresolved. The interval also includes nonzero differences.

zh.caption: 图8. A减B的差值估计为1.2 ms，误差棒为给定的双侧95%置信区间，范围是−0.8至3.2 ms。参考线标出零差值。
zh.results: 95%置信区间跨过零值（图8），尚不能确定差值的正负；该区间同时包含非零差值。
